# Vendored upstream

The `cugb_jwc_api` directory contains the list/detail client, models, and HTML parser selected from:

- Repository: `https://github.com/SuperL-2233/CUGBJwcAPI`
- Commit: `d9e3696bf7196715092d3911c516e5890b098eab`
- Upstream version: `1.1.0`
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)

Server, CLI, settings, API routing, and in-memory repository modules were not copied because the AstrBot plugin calls the public read-only source directly and owns its own SQLite cache.
